witness.title: The Septuagint Version of the Old Testament: According to the Vatican Text, Translated into English
witness.date_statement: 1851; locally captured from eBible.org's digital edition
witness.repository_or_publisher: Sir Lancelot Charles Lee Brenton; digital presentation by eBible.org
witness.editorial_policy: The historical English wording, spellings, names, chapter sequence, and verse labels returned on the four source pages are preserved. The local captures are browser-visible text, not raw HTML or byte-for-byte HTTP bodies.

coverage.structure_description: Four browser-visible chapter-page captures; 85 contiguous English verse labels (22, 23, 18, 22). This inventory does not prove completeness of the printed edition.
coverage.supplements_and_editorial_signs: No editor-supplied additions were identified in the page-text extracts. Raw HTML and print apparatus were not captured.
coverage.numbering_policy: Source labels 1–22, 1–23, 1–18, and 1–22 are retained per chapter. Matching labels are navigation aids, not verified one-to-one equivalents with the separate Geʽez transcription.

rights.statement: eBible.org identifies Brenton's 1851 English translation as public domain. This claim applies to the historical English translation only; it does not grant rights in other layers or in eBible.org's page design.
rights.territory_or_term_limits: Public-domain status is recorded from the cited eBible.org notice; no claim is made about other editions or website presentation.

review_dimensions.scope: Four eBible.org chapter pages identify Ruth and the Brenton English Septuagint; no printed witness was inspected.
review_dimensions.notes: Digital page identity is recorded; identity with every detail of the printed 1851 edition is not independently collated.

review_dimensions.scope: All four chapter URLs and local captures are ordered 1–4.
review_dimensions.notes: Confirms the inspected source-page inventory, not completeness of the printed edition.

review_dimensions.scope: 85 contiguous numbered units parsed from the four captured page-text extracts.
review_dimensions.notes: Parser checks labels and nonempty units; it does not independently collate wording against live pages or print.

review_dimensions.scope: No independent review against the Greek Septuagint or Brenton's printed 1851 edition.
review_dimensions.notes: The English translation is based on Greek, not directly on the archive's Geʽez transcription.

review_dimensions.scope: eBible.org's public-domain notice for Brenton's 1851 English translation.
review_dimensions.notes: This does not clear rights in the Geʽez transcription or the source site's page presentation.

additional_notes: This is a Greek-to-English historical translation paired for comparison with the locally bundled Geʽez transcription. It is not a direct translation from Geʽez or an aligned replacement. The page capture, structural checks, and public-domain claim are each bounded as described; textual accuracy and complete-edition coverage remain unknown.
